permission_denials.command:
python3 -c "
import yaml, json, sys
text = open('journals/2026-08-20-routine-handover-check.md').read()
fm = text.split('---\n')[1]
core = yaml.safe_load(fm)
schema = json.load(open('.claude/skills/investigate/journal.schema.json'))
try:
    import jsonschema
    jsonschema.validate(core, schema)
    print('schema: VALID')
except ImportError:
    print('jsonschema not installed; YAML parses OK')
# referential integrity
eids = {e['id'] for e in core['evidence']}
refs = [r for h in core['hypotheses'] for r in h['evidence_for']+h['evidence_against']]
missing = [r for r in refs if r not in eids]
print('refs resolve:', not missing, missing or '')
print('verdict:', core['verdict'], '| root_cause present:', 'root_cause' in core)
"
